meta.note: Expected paths are vault-relative, and a path may be a filed document as readily as a note - a PDF under Files/ is indexed under its own path and a hit on one is a hit. A query hits when ANY path in `expect` appears in the top k. `never` lists paths that must not appear at all, which is how the SEARCH_EXCLUDE_DIRS decoys are asserted. `arm` says which retrieval arm is supposed to answer: lexical and either are scored, dense is informational under the hashing embedder, threshold is informational until a score floor exists.

arms.lexical: BM25 should answer this outright - an exact identifier
arms.dense: needs real semantics; informational under the hashing embedder
arms.either: ordinary wording that overlaps the note's own vocabulary
arms.threshold: should ideally return nothing; informational until a score floor exists
